cards.title: Paisaje arquitectónico cálido y humano orientado al futuro
cards.description: Consistent AgntiaPro art direction: warm editorial European design magazine, ivory #fcfaf6, ink #242421, subtle violet #6550dd and champagne gold #b49665 only as accents, beautiful natural materials, refined realism, quiet cinematic light, generous negative space, excellent photographic composition. No readable text, letters, logos, branding, UI, watermarks, neon, futuristic dashboards, stock-photo clichés. Quiet sunlit contemporary pavilion of warm limestone and translucent glass opening onto a green garden, one small human figure walking naturally, hopeful human-scale technology future, calm sophisticated editorial photography, no science-fiction motifs.
